title: Charging the Acme Widget
content: The Acme Widget 1.0 charges through its micro-USB port. A full charge takes four hours, and a fully charged Acme Widget 1.0 runs for twelve hours.

title: Resetting the Acme Widget
content: To reset the Acme Widget 1.0 to its factory settings, hold down the power button for ten seconds until the status light flashes blue.

title: Charging the Acme Widget
content: The Acme Widget 2.0 charges through its USB-C port. A full charge takes ninety minutes, and a fully charged Acme Widget 2.0 runs for eighteen hours.

title: Resetting the Acme Widget
content: To reset the Acme Widget 2.0 to its factory settings, hold down the power and volume buttons together for five seconds until the status light flashes green.

title: Connecting the Acme Widget Pro to Wi-Fi
content: The Acme Widget Pro 1.0 connects to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi networks only. Pair it with a network through the Settings page of the Acme Companion app.

title: Acme Widget Pro Warranty
content: The Acme Widget Pro 1.0 comes with a one-year limited warranty, which covers manufacturing defects but not accidental damage.

title: Connecting the Acme Widget Pro to Wi-Fi
content: The Acme Widget Pro 2.0 connects to both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi networks. Pair it with a network by scanning the QR code on the base of the device with the Acme Companion app.

title: Acme Widget Pro Warranty
content: The Acme Widget Pro 2.0 comes with a three-year warranty, which covers manufacturing defects and one accidental damage repair.
